company.name: Brightpath
company.description: Bite-sized courses for professionals, on iOS, Android and the web. New users pick a goal during onboarding and finish a first lesson.

title: Brightpath: fewer new users get started
brief: Activation, the share of new users who finish their first lesson on day one, fell 18% in the last 7 days compared with the week before. Growth reviews it every Monday, and the head of growth wants an answer before then. Find where the drop comes from and what to do about it.

rootCause.summary: Android 4.2.0 crashes on the goal-picker screen during onboarding.
rootCause.explanation: Activation collapsed only for new users on Android 4.2.0, from the day it shipped. iOS 4.2.0, older Android versions and the web are flat, so the change is in that build, not in who is signing up.
rootCause.idealAction: Halt the Android 4.2.0 rollout, ship a hotfix for the onboarding crash, and check crash reports for that screen.
idealPath: Confirm the drop in activation over time
Break down by platform: only Android drops
Break down by app version: only Android 4.2.0, starting on release day
Rule out the paid social campaign: its users activate a little less, but only by a few points

falseLeads.explanation: The new paid social campaign brings slightly less motivated users, but their activation dips by a few points on every platform. It cannot explain a drop concentrated in one app version.

actionOptions.label: Halt the Android 4.2.0 rollout and ship a hotfix for onboarding
Pause the paid social campaign until activation recovers
Start a redesign of the onboarding flow on every platform
Wait another week to see whether activation recovers
